title: Technical Analysis of Cryptocurrency: AI-Powered Smart Money Tracking & Market Insights
summary: Use AI to analyze cryptocurrency charts, smart-money activity, and market signals. See how Energent.ai turns on-chain data into actionable insights.
body_markdown:
Explore a workflow for organizing cryptocurrency charts, market data, and on-chain records for analysis. Review source timestamps, assumptions, and extracted figures before interpreting a pattern.


## Define the data and question


Choose the asset, trading pair, observation period, and question you want to examine. Identify the exchange or data provider, quote currency, timezone, and sampling interval. Records from different venues may describe different markets.


For on-chain records, keep the network, transaction identifiers, timestamps, and source definitions. A wallet movement alone does not establish an owner's identity or intent.


## Organize the records


Ask Energent.ai to organize the supplied charts, tables, or exports into a consistent dataset. Keep price observations separate from commentary and label missing values. Check units and timestamps before combining sources.


Specify any indicator or calculation, including its period and inputs. A moving average based on daily closes answers a different question from one based on hourly observations.


## Check the analysis against its sources


Compare extracted values with the original records. Inspect duplicate timestamps, gaps, outliers, and changes in the data provider's definitions. Recompute sample indicators from the inputs before interpreting the chart.


Request an independent audit using the source files and your checking criteria. Review the findings, unresolved questions, and calculation trail before exporting the result.


## Keep conclusions tied to the evidence


Use the output to describe the supplied data and its assumptions. This guide does not establish forecast accuracy, investment returns, or measured time or cost savings. A pattern in historical data does not establish a future price movement.
